name: repack_nibbles_into_words
description: Packs groups of three source bytes into two-byte output words by taking high nibbles from them, for a fixed count of 32 words. It only does this when a flag returned by a preceding call is set.

name: decode_run_length_bitplanes
description: Expands a run-length encoded stream into 40-byte-wide rows across four planes spaced 8000 bytes apart. A negative count repeats one byte, while a non-negative count copies literal bytes.

name: find_iff_chunk_size
description: Checks that the buffer starts with a FORM container of type ILBM, then walks its sub-chunks and returns the size of the first chunk whose ID matches the requested value. If nothing matches, it returns the requested value unchanged.

name: dispatch_mode_handlers
description: Stores a 16-bit argument in a global, then runs the handler sequence for a mode value: modes 1 and 3 call twice, modes 2 and 4 call once, and any other value returns the mode minus four.

name: copy_bounded_string_field
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from a fixed source into a buffer, stopping at 30 characters or at a null. It terminates the copy and stores the copied length in an output byte.

name: match_data_chunk_length
description: Looks for a DATA chunk tag at the source, stores its following length word, and waits on a status call until it returns zero. It returns the second value only when it equals the stored length.

name: increment_retry_counter_limited
description: Increments a 16-bit counter up to a limit of 80, but only when a status word is zero after a helper call. Otherwise the counter is left as it is.

name: xor_buffer_with_rolling_key
description: XORs each byte of a source buffer with a key that starts from a fixed seed and advances by one per byte. The result is written to the destination for the requested byte count.

name: write_data_chunk_rows
description: Initialises a 40-byte row stride and a 16-bit row counter, writes a DATA tag followed by the length and a stored offset into the output. It then calls helpers for each row until the length is used up or 80 rows are done.

name: accumulate_bytes_into_key
description: Seeds a four-byte buffer with the text 1234, then adds each source byte into one of the four positions in turn, wrapping around. It repeats for the requested byte count.

name: set_disk_label_block
description: Clears a 128-entry block and copies a label of up to 30 characters into it, falling back to a stored default label when the input is empty. It sets fixed type and count fields and adjusts a checksum slot against the block contents.

name: clear_128_long_block
description: Zeroes 128 consecutive 32-bit words starting at the address register pointer.

name: set_named_volume_block
description: Clears a 128-entry block and copies a name of up to 30 characters into it, then sets type and count fields that differ from the blank-label variant. It adjusts the checksum slot afterwards, using the title text that the code references.

name: xor_copy_with_rolling_key
description: Copies a buffer while XORing each byte with a rolling key seeded from a fixed constant, advancing the key by one per byte. It is the same transform as the in-place variant, applied between two different buffers.

name: passthrough_helper_call
description: Calls one helper and returns the two input registers unchanged. It does no other work of its own.

name: checksum_and_copy_masked_blocks
description: Computes an inverted one's-complement checksum over a 256-long buffer and stores it after that buffer. Under a flag it builds a bitmask from ten bits, copies the selected 128-iteration segments, and retries up to four times.

name: install_vector_and_relocate_code
description: Stores a routine address in a low-memory vector slot and writes a disable mask to a global hardware word twice. It then copies a small code block into low memory and jumps to it.

name: relocate_code_and_jump
description: Writes a disable mask to a global hardware word twice, copies a small code block into low memory and jumps to it. The same transfer is used by its sibling routines.

name: relocate_code_irq_dma_off
description: Clears the interrupt and DMA enable bits by writing to the custom chip control registers. It then copies a small code block into low memory and jumps to it.

name: copy_code_block_and_jump
description: Copies a small block of code from the routine's own address into low memory and jumps to it. It does not touch a vector or any hardware register.

name: copy_block_and_call_relocated
description: Copies longwords from a source block into a fixed low-memory destination, then calls into the copied code through an unresolved pointer. It is the forward-order relocation variant.

name: copy_block_backwards_and_jump
description: Copies longwords backwards from a fixed source end address into low memory, then jumps to the routine it has placed there. It is the reverse-order relocation variant.

name: copy_block_backwards_and_call
description: Copies longwords backwards from a source offset plus count into a destination computed relative to an unresolved jump table, then calls the copied code.

name: show_title_screen_and_halt
description: Enables display DMA and copper through the custom chip control register, clears a block of memory and draws an image into the bitplanes. It then loads 16 color registers from a table, and the referenced text names the roster disk before it halts in an endless loop.

name: walk_string_list_calling_helper
description: Walks a list of zero-terminated strings and calls a helper for each character of the last entry it scans, stopping at an empty entry. It does not change the input data.

name: emit_string_list_characters
description: Walks a list of zero-terminated strings, calling a helper for every character, and ends when it reaches a second terminator. It returns a value taken from the caller's stack.

name: walk_string_list_returning_stack
description: Walks a list of zero-terminated strings with the same character-by-character helper calls as its sibling routines, and returns the 8-byte value found on the caller's stack.

name: return_stack_pair_unchanged
description: Returns the 8-byte value found on the caller's stack without doing any other work.

name: draw_bitplane_tile_column
description: Checks that a column and row lie inside a 40-by-25 grid, then writes eight bytes down a column in each of four bitplanes with a 40-byte row stride. The bits are combined with a mask by XOR, and out-of-range positions return without drawing.

name: unpack_checksummed_token_stream
description: Decompresses a token-based stream into a buffer using literal, repeat and copy tokens. It keeps a running sum and returns the decoded size only when the sum matches a fixed trailer value, otherwise it returns the input value unchanged.

name: unpack_token_stream_checked
description: Decodes a token-compressed block using copy, repeat and literal tokens, and verifies a trailing value against a fixed end constant. It returns the decoded size on success and the input value otherwise.

name: unpack_token_stream_reverse_copy
description: Variant of the token decoder that writes one back-reference copy in reverse order, and checks the trailing value against a fixed constant.

name: unpack_token_stream_fill_runs
description: Decodes a token stream that expands fill runs of one repeated word, and checks the trailing value against a fixed constant.

name: unpack_token_stream_byte_runs
description: Decodes a token stream that expands runs of one repeated byte alongside literal bytes, and checks the trailing value against a fixed constant.

name: return_stack_long_unchanged
description: Returns the 32-bit value found on the caller's stack without any change, doing no other work.

name: verify_trailing_checksum_words
description: Subtracts a block of words from a running total and compares the final total with a fixed trailer value. It returns the doubled word count when the check passes and the input value otherwise.

name: copy_words_checking_running_sum
description: Copies a block of words while subtracting each word from a running total, and returns the doubled count only when the final total equals a fixed value. Otherwise it returns the input value unchanged.

name: set_cia_b_lines_high
description: Writes all-ones to the CIA B port register and its direction register, which sets every line of the port high.

name: clear_large_work_buffer
description: Zeroes 1408 consecutive longwords starting at a fixed offset from the base pointer, which clears a large work buffer.

name: copy_counted_words
description: Calls a helper to get a count, then copies that many 16-bit words from the source to the destination, reducing the count by two per word.

name: copy_words_register_count
description: Copies 16-bit words from a source to a destination for a count held in a register, reducing the count by two per word. It is the register-count variant of the counted copy.

name: init_drive_state_record
description: Stores 200 in a 16-bit state field and sets one byte field to zero and another to all-ones. It only writes the record fields and does not touch any hardware register.

name: seek_disk_cylinder_stepwise
description: Checks that the cylinder, side and drive numbers are in range, then selects the drive and side through the CIA B port lines. It steps the head toward the target cylinder with a delay between steps, using a status bit to decide each step.

name: retry_until_status_clear
description: Repeatedly calls a helper and returns as soon as its result flag is clear, decrementing a byte counter between attempts and giving up when the counter reaches zero.

name: read_mfm_sectors_from_track
description: Sets the disk sync word and DMA pointer, then scans a raw MFM track buffer for sync patterns. It decodes sector headers and data by combining odd and even bits, checks their checksums, and stores up to eleven sector entries.

name: find_mfm_data_word
description: Scans forward through a raw MFM buffer until it reaches a non-zero entry, then returns that word masked to its data bit positions. It returns the input value when the scan reaches the end.

name: write_mfm_track_with_retries
description: Builds a bitmask of eleven sector slots, copies sector data into the track buffer for each selected slot, and retries the disk write up to four times. It sets a status word to 200 at the end.

name: encode_mfm_track_image
description: Builds an MFM track image of eleven sectors, writing two sync words and encoded header and data fields for each one. It then clears the top bit of each word, starts the disk DMA transfer and waits for it to complete.

name: fill_buffer_with_alternating_word
description: Fills a word buffer with an alternating bit-pattern word, counting words from the length register halved.

name: decode_mfm_longword_pair
description: Splits a longword of interleaved MFM bits into two data longwords, one from the odd bit positions and one from the even ones. Clock bits are removed by masking with alternating bit patterns.

name: compare_sector_buffers_until_mismatch
description: Walks up to eleven stored sector buffers and compares each one with a reference buffer longword by longword. It stops at the first mismatch and returns when all entries match.

name: initialize_system_state_sequence
description: Sets up system state and runs a sequence of helper calls, including a check for a four-letter TEST marker in memory that changes one configuration value. Decoding ends in an unrecovered tail, so the remaining behaviour is unreliable.

name: call_library_and_start_slave
description: Calls through an object pointer and a library base offset, sets a status variable to four, and makes further calls through the library and a jump table. It is the entry stub of the slave module.

name: patch_jump_stub_then_call
description: Writes a return instruction and a long jump instruction into a code area, pointing the jump at another routine. It then calls into the patched area through an unresolved jump table.

name: patch_call_to_branch
description: Checks whether a patched word matches a subroutine call opcode with a fixed address word, and if so rewrites it as a short branch. It then calls through an unresolved jump table.

name: boot_load_graphics_and_track
description: Boot block entry that opens the graphics library and the trackdisk device through exec, allocates memory and sends trackdisk requests to read data into it. On success it transfers control to the loaded code and then closes the device.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only undecodable bad instruction data, so no behaviour can be recovered from it.

name: boot_open_trackdisk_and_read
description: Boot block entry that opens the trackdisk device through exec, allocates a request block and sends a read to load a track into memory. It closes the device afterwards and returns zero on success.

name: setup_copper_bitplane_pointers
description: Clears a block of memory, writes copper-list entries that point the bitplane pointer registers at the video buffers, and waits for the blitter. It then waits on the vertical-blank bit and restores the DMA and interrupt enable state.

name: enter_loaded_block
description: Calls a helper, then transfers control to the start of the block it has loaded.

name: check_crm_marker_then_call
description: Compares the first longword at the input address with the four-character marker CrM! and calls a helper when they match.

name: decode_backreference_stream
description: Decodes a variable-length bit stream of literals and back-references, copying earlier output from computed offsets chosen by length tables. It runs until the output count is used up and returns the last value decoded.

name: select_half_or_input
description: Returns the input word unchanged unless a flag is set to one, in which case it returns the second word shifted right by one.

name: mask_table_word_lookup
description: Looks up a word in a fixed table using a doubled index register as the offset, then ANDs it with the input word and returns the result.

name: setup_copper_with_graphics_library
description: Opens the graphics library, clears a memory block, and writes copper list pointers for the bitplanes. It waits for the copper start, restores the saved DMA and interrupt enable bits, and closes the library.

name: wait_blitter_then_vpos_line
description: Sets blitter priority and waits until the blitter status bit clears, then clears the priority and waits until the raster position reaches a fixed line.

name: draw_text_string_glyphs
description: After waiting for the blitter, draws each character of a zero-terminated string by copying 13 rows of font data with an 80-byte row stride. It stops at a line feed.

name: configure_blitter_registers
description: Increments a frame counter, waits for the blitter to finish, and writes pointer and size fields into the blitter register block. It sets the source, destination and control values for the next blit.

name: verify_device_then_halt
